name: r12_tank_discharge_heat_supply
title: R12 tank discharge with heat supply (uniform-state open system)
summary: A 25 L rigid tank of R12 (90 % liquid by volume, 25 C) is discharged through a nozzle at 100 kPa and -20 C with 180 m/s while heat keeps it at 25 C until only saturated vapour is left. The unsteady uniform-state first law gives the mass that left the tank (28.67 kg) and the heat supplied (4037 kJ).

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of the source file: 21 common variables, 8 differ at rtol=1e-3. The enthalpy/internal-energy differences are a reference-state offset (Q is independent of it); the rest comes from the R12 saturated vapour volume (+1.06 % in CoolProp), Q differs by 2.4e-3. With the EES property values substituted the stored solution is reproduced to 2.1e-10.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (21 variables in common with the model; extra EES variable P = 1 is unused), converted with --ees-units
verification.notes: compare_solution.py (rtol=1e-3, --ees-units): '21 common variables, 8 differ'; largest relative difference 7.34e-01 (u_i, reference-state offset; h_out_n 4.78e-01, u_f 4.79e-01); excluding h_out_n, u_f, u_i the largest is 1.06e-02 (v_v_i, m_v_f, m_v_i, x_i), Q 2.41e-03, m_ej 3.9e-04. A shift of 1e5 J/kg of u_f, u_i and h_out_n leaves Q unchanged. Substituting the EES values of v_l_i, v_v_i, u_f, u_i, h_out_n: 21 common variables, 4 differ at rtol=1e-12, largest 2.09e-10 (m_ej).
